from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional
from services.db import connect
from services.calculations import recompute_health
from services.agents import account_specialist, goal_specialist, insurance_specialist, salary_specialist
from lib.types import Account, Goal, Insurance, Salary

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/finance/settings")

@router.post("/accounts/{id}/archive")
async def archive_account(id: int, archived_at: Optional[datetime] = None):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        account = account_specialist.get_account(conn, id)
        if not account:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
        
        if account.archived_at:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Account already archived")
        
        if account_specialist.has_active_holdings(conn, id):
            account_specialist.cascade_archive_holdings(conn, id)
        else:
            account_specialist.set_archived_at(conn, id, archived_at)
        
        recompute_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content={"status": "success"})
    finally:
        conn.close()

@router.post("/goals")
async def create_goal(goal: Goal):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        goal_specialist.create_goal(conn, goal)
        recompute_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content={"status": "success"})
    finally:
        conn.close()

@router.post("/insurance")
async def create_insurance(insurance: Insurance):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        insurance_specialist.create_insurance(conn, insurance)
        recompute_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content={"status": "success"})
    finally:
        conn.close()

@router.post("/salary")
async def create_salary(salary: Salary):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        salary_specialist.create_salary(conn, salary)
        recompute_health(conn)
        return JSONResponse(content={"status": "success"})
    finally:
        conn.close()
